headline: Frequent Rework of Token Constants File
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates a focus on adding support for new Python features (e.g., PEP 798, PEP 701) and cleaning up the codebase. The token constants file is frequently touched due to its foundational role in the parsing process, which is affected by changes in language specifications and syntax detection.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the token constants to ensure they align with the latest Python PEPs and language features.
Establish a clear documentation process for any changes made to token constants to prevent future confusion and rework.
Implement automated tests that validate the token constants against the expected behavior for various Python versions, ensuring compatibility.
Assign a dedicated owner for the token constants file to streamline future changes and maintain consistency.
owner_hint: Assign a single engineer to oversee changes to the token constants.
